messages.content: Hey Jean! Quick question about the interdisciplinary project we discussed. Do you have time to meet this week?
Hi Shem! Yes, I'd love to connect. How about Wednesday during our shared prep period?
Perfect! I was thinking we could do a unit where students calculate nutritional values and budgets for meal planning. Combines your life skills with my math curriculum.
I love that idea! We could even have them present their meal plans to the class. Real-world application of percentages and budgeting.
Exactly what I was thinking. Here is my location for our Wednesday meeting.
See you there! I'll bring some sample meal planning worksheets I've used before.
Jean! Did you see the email about the new curriculum guidelines?
Just read it. I'm concerned about the timeline they're giving us to implement changes.
Same. Want to draft a response together? I think if we come from multiple departments it'll carry more weight.
Great idea. Let's loop in Mary too - she mentioned similar concerns at lunch yesterday.
Thanks so much for sharing your classroom management strategies last week. I tried the 'choice board' approach and it worked wonders!
So glad to hear that! Which options did your students gravitate toward?
Mostly the creative writing prompts and the partner discussion option. They really responded to having autonomy.
Hey Shem, I have a student who's really struggling with word problems. Any strategies you'd recommend?
Absolutely! I use a 'CUBES' strategy - Circle numbers, Underline the question, Box key words, Evaluate steps, Solve and check.

metadata.transcript: I also find it helpful to have students draw a picture or diagram of the problem first. For students with IEPs, I often provide a graphic organizer that breaks down each step...

messages.content: This is so helpful! Would you mind if I observed your class sometime?
Of course! I'm doing a word problem unit next week. Come by Tuesday 3rd period.
Team meeting reminder: Tomorrow at 3:15 in my room. We need to discuss the parent-teacher conference schedule.
I'll be there! Should we also talk about the field trip logistics?
Good idea. I have the permission slip template ready to share.
Can we add student progress reports to the agenda? I'm seeing some concerning patterns in a few students.
Absolutely. Updated agenda: 1) P-T conferences, 2) Field trip, 3) Student progress. See everyone tomorrow!
Has anyone tried the new Desmos activities for quadratics? My students loved them!
Yes! The marble slides activity is a game changer. Even my reluctant learners were engaged.
I'm putting together a PD session on Desmos for our school. Would either of you want to co-facilitate?
Count me in! I use it for physics simulations too - could show cross-curricular applications.
This is turning into something great! Let's set up a Jam session to plan it out?
Big news: Our robotics team made it to regionals! 🎉
Congratulations Amanda! That's incredible! What challenge are they competing in?
The sustainability challenge - they built a robot that sorts recyclables. The kids designed the whole sorting algorithm themselves.
That's amazing! Would love to have them present to my coding class. Great real-world application.
Carlos here - I could tie this into our environmental science unit! Cross-school collaboration?
Love it! Let's set something up. This is exactly why I love this community.
First year survival check-in: How's everyone holding up as we approach the end of the year?
Honestly? Exhausted but proud. My students have grown so much. Still struggling with work-life balance though.
That's so normal for year one. Remember: you can't pour from an empty cup. What's one thing you're doing for yourself this weekend?
Aisha's right. Self-care isn't selfish - it's necessary. I'm going to the botanical garden Saturday if anyone wants to join!
I'd love that! Count me in. Teacher meetups outside of school have been so helpful for my mental health.
Anyone up for trivia night next Friday? Found a place in the Village that does education-themed rounds 😂
Education-themed trivia?! I'm definitely in. We're going to crush the literary questions.
Count me in! I'll bring my A-game for any art history questions 🎨
This sounds like so much fun! I need a night out. What time?
Excited to announce our summer book study! We'll be reading 'We Want to Do More Than Survive' by Bettina Love. First discussion July 20th.
Such an important book! I'll be there. Will there be virtual options for those traveling?
Yes! We'll have a hybrid option. I'll share the Zoom link closer to the date.
This community keeps me grounded. Thank you for organizing this, Marcus. 🙏🏾
Reminder: Staff meeting moved to Thursday this week due to PD on Wednesday.
Thanks for the heads up! Will the agenda be shared beforehand?
Yes, I'll post it by end of day today. Main topics: budget updates and summer school planning.
Just finished Chapter 3 and I'm blown away by the research on the brain-culture connection. Who else is caught up?
Just started! Already highlighting everything. The section on 'cognitive load' is making me rethink my lesson structure.
The 'ready for rigor' framework is gold. I'm creating a one-pager to share with my department.
Just uploaded my full coding curriculum for middle school - 12 weeks of lessons, all free to use and modify! Link in the resources folder.
Kai, you're amazing! I've been looking for something exactly like this. Can't wait to adapt it for my robotics kids.
This is why I love Lime. Teachers helping teachers. ❤️
Who's going to the Maker Faire this weekend? Would be great to connect in person!
I'll be there with some of my physics students! We're presenting our Rube Goldberg machine.
Chemistry demo booth here! Come see some controlled explosions 💥 (all safety-approved, I promise)
Let's do a Lime meetup at 2pm by the main stage? We can all connect and maybe get a group photo.
